question: Who wrote the book ‘The Legend of Lakshmi Prasad’?
solution:
Correct Answer **Twinkle Khanna**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **"Legend of Lakshmi Prasad"** is a collection of **four stories on feminism** written by Indian author **Twinkle Khanna.**
 
• The book was published on **7 November 2016** by **Juggernaut books.**
 
• Book written by her was **Mrs. Funny bones, Pyjamas are Forgiving.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information:__****Dr. APJ. Abdul Kalam:**

 
• "Wings of Fire" is the autobiography of **Dr. APJ. Abdul Kalam**
 
• Notable works are:
 
 
• The luminous spark.
 
• India 2020.
 
• Mission India
 
• **Ignited Minds.**
 
• **Indomitable Spirit.**
 
• **Inspiring Thoughts.**
